_meta.what: Hand-written map from project slug to the EXACT image URLs as rendered by Ephraim's live Wix site, harvested from research/wix/{work,home,about}.html.
_meta.url_rule: Every url below is byte-for-byte what the Wix page rendered - media id, ~mv2.<ext>, transform segment and trailing filename untouched. fetch-wix.py rewrites ONLY the transform segment (the part between /v1/ and the trailing filename) to ask for a large rendition, and keeps any /v1/crop/x_,y_,w_,h_/ prefix, which is the client's own framing. Never build a bare /media/<id> URL: Wix answers 403.
_meta.rendered_sizes_are_placeholders: Most rendered URLs are the w_147 blurred lazy-load placeholder Wix ships in the HTML. That is fine - the URL is a template; only 'native' below says how much real pixel data exists behind it.
_meta.native: [width, height] of the original upload, taken from the page's own imageData JSON. This is the ceiling: Wix does not upscale, so a fit/w_3000 request returns at most this.
_meta.status: PLACEHOLDERS. Ephraim's originals replace these - see docs/images.md for the swap.
